hypotheses.justification: Split on h < 1 / 2; the original proof handles that case. Otherwise 2 * h ≥ 1, so the definition of SimilarityCoordinates.coordinateQ gives q h y = 1 for every y. Thus flattening h f y = f (Real.log y.2.1). This is ContDiffAt ℝ 2 at p by hf, smoothness of the projection, and ContDiffAt.log using hs.ne'. The physicalHeat_contDiffAt step still uses only hh, ht, and hs; the final multiplication and division are unchanged. This also covers h = 1 / 2, since h is fixed and q is identically 1 in that case.
